multi-screens.name: Multi Screens 1.10.1
multi-screens.body:
Enter saves a note.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Multi-Screens-Setup-1.10.1.exe` | 78.0 MB | `113D34038B1921CB1E82B30BB5461A5490CAAD6CB99B1B034D95AF95EC4A81FD` |
| `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.1.pdf` | 4.1 MB | `81424EB83272BAB4D42682E98857C6318A062BB950C22F90893C0E1DB9D30AA0` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Enter saves the note** being written; **Shift+Enter** starts a new line (Ctrl+Enter still saves too). The same in Smart Snap's comment box.
- **The handbook**, `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.1.pdf`, with Enter on the Notes and Keys pages.

### Updating from 1.10.0

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- The packaged app, in a test profile with the handbook's sample site: a note typed over two lines with Shift+Enter stays open, and Enter saves it with both lines.
- 1.10.0 installed offers this version (the handbook's update picture).
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

smart-snap.name: Smart Snap 1.1.5
smart-snap.body:
Enter saves the comment, the comment box opens at once, Copy as picture in the bar, and sharper snaps.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Smart-Snap-Setup-1.1.5.exe` | 78.0 MB | `BDA944D3A875EB3C11729CBFC4620DE1E0E4A56040FDFA985C05A43451724378` |
| `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.1.5.pdf` | 3.6 MB | `EE0A9408B5769103EDFF092E91D7E2B1CB9A202A983031068F8CFDA19565D725` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Enter saves the comment**; Shift + Enter starts a new line.
- **The comment box opens the moment you let go** of the mouse (it waited about half a second for the picture before); the picture is taken meanwhile.
- **Copy as picture in the bar**, beside Create PDF report: the whole report on the clipboard as one picture, with the title and name last typed in the report form.
- **A narrow window**: the bar's shortcut labels make way first, then Copy as picture keeps only its icon, so the bar fits down to the smallest window.

### Fixed

- **A faint light edge around area snaps** (1.1.4): the selection, meant to be left out of the picture, was not, because Windows ignores that setting for a window not yet on screen. It is now set once the window shows.
- **Slightly stretched snaps on a scaled display**: a 2560 × 1600 display at 150% came out 2562 × 1601, a little soft, because every display was captured at one shared size and Electron rounds a scaled size. Each display is now captured at its own exact size, and only the display being snapped.

### Updating from 1.1.4

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- The packaged app on two displays (2560 × 1600 at 150% and 3440 × 1440), each covered by a test window of coded colours: a live area, a frozen area and a full-screen snap on each were exact, pixel for pixel, with nothing of the selection or the comment box in them.
- With the real mouse and keyboard on both displays: a comment typed over two lines (Shift + Enter) and saved with Enter; the box appeared about 20 ms after the release.
- Copy as picture, from the bar and from the report form; Create report.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

instant-share.name: Instant Share 1.3.4
instant-share.body:
The handbook in the SCAFFApps style, Settings without scrolling, and scrollbars in the SCAFFApps colours.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Instant-Share-Setup-1.3.4.exe` | 13.8 MB | `82890597DE5D6762DE53BD75B28E3D3E60028ECA4D2B19877DED5697EB92EB75` |
| `Instant-Share-1.3.4.apk` | 70 KB | `80327A7CCF54A3B0A9639D4DD0ED3C6D78CF5102B2E5542261DA36EA563B52C9` |
| `instantshare.py` | 169 KB | `0B7C207D5BD63D2EA2C43C1BF869451E7720692F66D307DEA6F407A0FA780F23` |
| `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` | 143 KB | `0FEE3D7AD39B18F748FC67EE2ABDDF5CCF77E01668709074FEEEB52D522CD01C` |
| `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.4.pdf` | 3.1 MB | `BA2B788D48AF47D3D2D635C9E2970B11CDB7755DB957783B6DD18213C9C7D4E9` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, and Android 10 and newer. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The handbook**, `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.4.pdf`: 15 pages with pictures in the SCAFFApps brochure style, from setting up to privacy. The SCAFFApps Suite opens it from Handbooks.
- **Settings without scrolling**: on a laptop-wide window the sheet is wider, with its sections in two or three columns; phones keep one column.
- **Scrollbars in the SCAFFApps style**: a slim purple bar on no track, wider under the pointer; never the grey Windows bar. Phones keep their own.
- **"Published by SCAFFApps - www.scaffapps.com"** on the welcome page, the setup page, the page's footer, Settings > About, and the Android app's setup screen.

### Updating

- **Windows, from 1.3.0 to 1.3.3:** Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.
- **Android:** install the new app over the old one, or **Update now** in the app.

### Tested

- Updated from 1.3.3 by the installed SCAFFApps Suite 1.0.1, against a stand-in for GitHub offering this installer: downloaded, checked against both published checksums, Windows' permission, installed in 10 seconds; Windows lists 1.3.4.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer or the Android app.
- The handbook's pictures were taken from this version's own pages, with a made-up history and made-up devices.

scaffapps-suite.name: SCAFFApps Suite 1.0.2
scaffapps-suite.body:
Its own handbook, scrollbars in the SCAFFApps colours, and a home view that fits a small laptop.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Setup-1.0.2.exe` | 78.0 MB | `84D9DEE414DB3EEAEBD0A1EDB2E15031E346EDE2A0FEEE2276DBA6911EF286DC` |
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.2.pdf` | 3.8 MB | `9E0A7C925B4E016CB5C77AE9458BA98655A24856992FFFFE2BC467D6F25BA237` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Its own handbook**, `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.2.pdf`: 11 pages with pictures in the SCAFFApps brochure style. The apps' handbooks (Multi Screens 1.8.2, Smart Snap 1.1.2, Instant Share 1.3.4) are now on their releases, so **Handbooks** opens them.
- **Scrollbars in the SCAFFApps style**: a slim purple bar on no track, wider under the pointer; never the grey Windows bar.
- **The home view fits a small laptop** (1366 × 768) without scrolling.
- **"Published by SCAFFApps - www.scaffapps.com"** in Settings > About and at the foot of the sign-up window.

### Updating from 1.0.0 or 1.0.1

- **Update** on the Updates page, or the Suite's card in the sidebar. Windows asks for permission; the Suite closes, is updated and opens again.

### Tested

- The installed Suite 1.0.1, against a stand-in for GitHub offering the new versions, updated Smart Snap, Instant Share and Multi Screens with its own buttons (each downloaded, checked against both published checksums and installed with Windows' permission, in 9 to 10 seconds), then **updated itself** to 1.0.2: closed, installed and opened again, in 10 seconds. Windows lists all four new versions.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.
- The handbook's pictures were taken from this version, in a test profile, with a stand-in for GitHub and a made-up list of installed apps.
